_provenance: Output-shape fixture (producer schema). Input API shape pinned from a LIVE GDELT capture on 2026-06-13 at gdelt_timelinetone_api_shape.json (captured-from-producer). This file defines the PRODUCER OUTPUT shape only -- not the raw API shape. Values marked __is_*__ are type/format assertions -- NOT hardcoded producer outputs.
_api_contract_note: GDELT 2.0 DOC API timelinetone mode (free, no key). Real response shape (captured 2026-06-13): {query_details, timeline:[{series:Average Tone, data:[{date,value},...]}]}. The value field lives inside timeline[*].data[*], NOT at timeline[*] directly -- the old schema-derived fixture had the wrong nesting level causing tone=None in production.
_tone_normalization_note: GDELT AvgTone is in [-100, 100]. Producer normalizes to [-1, 1] (divide by 100). Tests assert -1.0 <= tone <= 1.0 (or None on unavailable) -- NOT a specific value.
_per_ticker_note: GDELT does not expose per-ticker filtering in the free timelinetone API. per_ticker is always null.
_endpoint_note: Uses mode=timelinetone (not mode=artlist). artlist carries NO per-article tone field in practice.

invariants.tone_bounds: when available=True and tone is not None: -1.0 <= tone <= 1.0
invariants.reason_d1_compliant: reason is type(exc).__name__ only -- never str(exc)
invariants.no_fabricated_tone: when GDELT returns no timeline entries or no value data: available=False (or available=True with tone=None), never a fabricated float
invariants.endpoint_uses_timelinetone: the producer MUST use mode=timelinetone, NOT mode=artlist. artlist has no per-article tone field in the free GDELT API.
invariants.series_nesting: timeline[*] is a series object with keys series and data; value fields are in data[*], not at series level.
